seams.mechanically_visible_pattern: permit_limits.csv parameter 70295 (Solids, total dissolved) for NM0020583 Outfall 001 has adjacent LIMIT_BEGIN_DATE/LIMIT_END_DATE intervals (2021-12-01/2024-11-30 vs 2024-12-01/2026-11-30) carrying different numeric LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR (497 vs 449 mg/L; 27664 vs 24992 lb/d). FY2025 (2024-10-01/2025-09-30) straddles the partition.
seams.purpose_dependency: A requires one applicable numeric limit per measurement/period.
seams.why_forced: Same permit/outfall/parameter with two dated numeric regimes forces applicable-limit selection. No prose is required to see the insufficiency of a single untensed limit.

seams.mechanically_visible_pattern: Cyanide 00720 appears as one numeric limit interval 2021-12-01/2026-11-30 covering the whole permit term. No second dated cyanide regime and no 12-month delay field exist in the participant CSVs.
seams.why_forced: Structured rows already present a single final-looking numeric cyanide limit spanning FY2025. The compliance-schedule delay is permit-prose-only. A structural compiler is not forced to ask about a schedule.

seams.mechanically_visible_pattern: Chlorine total residual 50060 has LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR=19, OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG=N, frequency 01/01. NODI_CODE 9 appears on some Farmington DMR rows, with no legend in the participant corpus.
seams.why_forced: Structure presents TRC as ordinary required numeric monitoring. The UV/chlorine-use condition is a permit footnote. NODI 9 is an uninterpreted code (generic), not the TRC-conditional seam itself.

seams.mechanically_visible_pattern: Many NM0020583 limit rows have empty LIMIT_VALUE_NMBR (Flow 50050, several toxics, WET codes, some 70295 statistic types) beside sibling rows with numeric limits and LIMIT_VALUE_QUALIFIER_CODE <= or >=.
seams.purpose_dependency: A explicitly distinguishes enforceable numeric comparison from report-only / not-applicable comparison.
seams.why_forced: Empty numeric limit beside a reported DMR value is a structural comparison insufficiency.

seams.purpose_dependency: B monitoring applicability depending on discharge occurrence; C no-discharge vs missing evidence.

seams.mechanically_visible_pattern: NM0000116 LIMIT_SET_NAME is DISCHARGE STORM RUNOFFS FROM STORAGE. DMR NODI_CODE C appears on 150 of 180 GCC rows; 30 rows have ordinary numeric DMR values.

seams.why_forced: Event-named limit set plus a repeated uninterpreted NODI code with mixed numeric rows is a structural applicability gap. NODI legend is not in the corpus; the gap is still visible as uninterpreted code + event-named set.

seams.mechanically_visible_pattern: No GCC WET first-discharge / once-per-5-years limit rows in participant CSVs.

seams.mechanically_visible_pattern: source_manifest.json lists, per permit, final_permit.pdf plus statement_of_basis.pdf and/or fact_sheet.pdf and reasonable_potential.pdf, with document-type filenames but no document text.
seams.purpose_dependency: A enforceable numeric limits; grounding of operative conditions.
seams.why_forced: Multiple document types for the same permit, some named as permits and others as fact sheets/statements of basis, make source-precedence a mechanically visible question if purposes require uniquely grounded operative limits. It does not require reading prose. It does not appear in the CSVs themselves.
